title: merchant.terminated.v1
description: A merchant reached the terminal state TERMINATED. Published by the Merchant Registry (BC-2) on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id, and consumed by every context. The guard requires zero payments in a non-terminal state before termination is permitted; openPaymentCount is carried so a consumer can assert that invariant rather than trust it.

previousState.description: The state the merchant was in immediately before termination.

openPaymentCount.description: Always 0 - the termination guard requires it. Carried so consumers can assert the invariant instead of assuming it, which is the difference between catching a guard regression and discovering it in an audit.

connectionsRevoked.description: How many gateway connections were revoked as part of termination.

dataRetentionUntil.description: When this merchant's financial records may be erased. Records are retained under the legal-obligation basis even after a right-to-erasure request, which is satisfied by crypto-shredding the tenant's data key for personal data only.
